leadStory: Liverpool threw away a two-goal lead to lose 2-3 to Monaco on Sunday, Andoni Iraola beaten on his Anfield bow and a second squandered two-goal lead in a week after the Leeds collapse; Isak and Wirtz scored before Golovin, Biereth and a late Paris Brunner turned it, exposing a thin bench and back line. Off the pitch Liverpool lodged a first formal £98.5m bid for Barcola (PSG braced to reject), made Mbaye a priority, saw Araujo pass his medical, and shut the door on a Gakpo sale.
